newspaper_device.description: The Xteink device id the issue is queued for (GET /api/devices); null: the newspaper-library actor's device_id, if the operator set one there

newspaper_sections.description: The newspaper's sections, one JSON string: a list of {name, queries (1-5, joined with OR), must, must_not, freshness (pd|pw|pm|py), count (1-20), site_include, site_exclude}; parsed and validated at the start of each run
newspaper_sections.value: [{"name": "Edge AI", "queries": ["edge AI hardware news"], "freshness": "pd", "count": 5}, {"name": "Open models", "queries": ["open source LLM release"], "freshness": "pw", "count": 5, "must_not": ["sponsored"]}]

newspaper_to.description: Who receives the newspaper (each must also be on the newspaper-email actor's recipients allowlist); empty: the email step fails and nothing is sent
